cover_letter.greeting: Dear TD Securities Global Transaction Banking Team,
paragraphs: I am applying for the Associate, Structured Trade & Export Finance role in New York. I am completing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli, after working at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this team is that the Associate works directly with the senior trade finance originators, so the work stays close to clients and to how companies actually fund their trade flows.

Two parts of my background fit that work. At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows and worked with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting and close for the ANZ region, which taught me how working capital moves through a business. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I created pitch materials for funding decisions. At Fordham I have added financial statement analysis and valuation coursework, including a DCF and LBO model on J.M. Smucker.

I would bring that analytical base and careful presentation work to the pitch decks, financial statement analysis and reporting your team relies on. Trade finance itself is new to me, and I want to learn it from your originators. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can help.
